notes: Corrected: the supplied in of 'encourage themselves in an evil purpose' moved from דָּבָר to the verb יְחַזְּקוּ, since דָּבָר is that verb's direct object in the Hebrew and rule 33 defers to rule 44 for a bare direct object reached through a supplied preposition.
Both lamed-plus-suffix phrases leave the preposition unrepresented under rule 40.
